visual_thesis: A session carries task conversation, plan and code changes into the same worktree in VS Code, followed by diff inspection, prompting/manual changes, local validation and update to its existing pull request.
composition_signature: Continuous session bridge and editor review staircase
layout: Three-part context bridge into a stepped local review sequence and same-PR destination
required_labels: Context supports review; it does not replace it
allowed_causal_edges: Open in VS Code preserves conversation, changes and worktree
Diff review and manual edits occur in existing worktree
Local checks precede final diff review and push
Push updates existing session pull request
excluded_claims: No copying to a disconnected session
